description: This file is a shell script used for testing and automating interactions with a Git and Perforce (p4) integration, particularly focusing on job management and changelist handling.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server (p4d) for testing purposes.

methods.name: p4_add_job
methods.description: Adds a new job to the Perforce system.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets the client view mapping in Perforce.

methods.name: p4 fix
methods.description: Associates a job with a specific changelist.

methods.name: git p4 clone
methods.description: Clones a depot from Perforce into a Git repository.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Removes or resets the git environment after tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output to verify test results.
